description: This Java class 'AdminServerContainer' implements a server container for managing an administrative socket interface in the OFBiz framework. It handles socket communication for commands like shutdown and status, manages server thread lifecycle, and interacts with the OFBiz start and configuration classes.

classes.name: AdminServerContainer
classes.description: A container class providing socket-based administrative control for an OFBiz server instance, including command processing and server lifecycle management.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the server socket and thread for listening to admin commands, based on configuration.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the admin server thread to listen for incoming connections.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Interrupts the server thread to stop listening for connections.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of this container.

methods.name: processClientRequest
methods.description: Handles incoming client requests, processes commands, and manages server shutdown if requested.

methods.name: determineClientCommand
methods.description: Parses the client request string to determine the command issued.

methods.name: isValidRequest
methods.description: Validates the format and authenticity of the incoming request string.

methods.name: prepareResponseToClient
methods.description: Prepares a response string based on the server's current state and the command received.
